notes: *was ... the ruler* is one discontinuous unit on `נָגִיד`, the clause's nominal predicate. The competing reading puts the copula on the fronted `לְ` as in vv. 2 and 4; it is set aside because this clause writes its own subject (`אֱלִיעֶזֶר`), so rule 49's closing paragraph sends the copula to the nominal predicate.
